rubric.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to one decimal; cohort means use unique per-file rounded totals
rubric.blind_order: All 16 AFTER files were viewed at original resolution and score vectors fixed before any BEFORE image or prior score. No prior reviewer scores read. Near-duplicate aliases applied afterwards without changing score vectors.

verdict.score_basis: notes cohort, after unique-image mean; settings is reported separately, not blended
verdict.reason: Notes unique-image mean is 7.8; phone Pages initial composition, same-page dirty state and measured control-border contrast require correction. Editor-only after mean is 8.3, which does not override other notes states.

inventory.near_duplicate_definition: same dimensions, changed pixels <0.1%, maximum channel delta <=8
inventory.correction: Supplied inventory records exact hashes only. Four AFTER workspace images and two BEFORE desktop workspace images also satisfy the rubric near-duplicate definition and are excluded from counts/means.

responsive.evidence: Supplied after manifest records overflow=0 at 390/1280; native fixture also has zero desktop overflow and usable row navigation. Expanded phone pane composition fails SOL-1. All scope paths and WebKit not checked.

save_preservation.evidence: SOL-2 source trace. Different-id path retains flushOpenPage; same-id path unconditionally clears dirty. No mutation-based save test run by reviewer.

issues.title: Opening Pages should reveal actual page choices
issues.detail: At 390x844 the expanded page pane is 256px high, top 217/bottom 473. The search starts at y505 and first row at y616, clipped by that pane; initial scrollTop is 0. The warning and heading consume the entire pane. Native keyboard/pointer selection can reach rows by auto-scrolling, so this is a discovery/initial-composition defect, not an assertion that pages are inaccessible.
issues.fix: Keep the recovery message available, but arrange the expanded phone pane so search and at least the current page plus another destination are visible immediately. For example, place notebook/recovery information outside the bounded row scroller, or compact/collapse the non-page information on phones. Capture the pane before locator auto-scrolling; assert a row intersects the pane viewport.

issues.title: Current-page dismissal also clears dirty edits through selectNote
issues.detail: The same-id click branch closes the disclosure and focuses the title, then falls through to selectNote(note). selectNote skips flushOpenPage for the same id and unconditionally markDirty(false). This cancels dirty-driven autosave/retry and makes subsequent flushOpenPage return true without flushing. The encrypted local draft/queue still exists; permanent loss is not proven. The flawed shared behavior predates this diff, but the new explicit same-page dismissal path continues to invoke it.
issues.fix: Make current-page reselection a true no-op for the document/save state: return after close/focus, or short-circuit the shared selectNote before it resets state. Add a focused browser regression with a dirty current page and a delayed/refused save; selecting that row must preserve dirty status and the normal save/retry guarantee.
issues.verification: Source-confirmed control-flow issue; no fault injection or note edits performed in this read-only review.

issues.title: Search and move-section boundaries fail the measured contrast gate
issues.detail: Native computed styles on the exact after bundle use rgba(24,35,38,.22) on white in light, and rgba(242,239,232,.24) on rgb(31,43,46) in dark for .note-search and .editor-actions select. Alpha-composited contrast is 1.57:1 and 2.06:1, below the contract 3:1 control boundary requirement. This is inherited styling, not a visual score deduction invented from pixels.
issues.fix: Consume the already-vendored --ky-field-border for these field boundaries, then measure all shipped themes including focus/state indicators. Do not change the palette or hand-edit vendored tokens.

issues.title: Finish the existing control geometry and idle save emphasis
issues.detail: Top Save is 32px high and move-section is 35px, while canvas controls are 40px. The saved editor shows an active filled Saved button plus top Save. Appearance has no visible current-section marker in its settings navigation. These are bounded polish issues, not reasons to rebuild the shell.
issues.fix: Use shared control sizing where these controls appear, keep an idle Saved state quiet, and make the existing settings location apparent if that can be done without changing routing.
